targets.summary: A string literal that interpolates values is missing its `f` prefix, so the placeholders print as literal text and are never filled in.
targets.adoption_evidence: Before: `"failed, even with retries: {e}"` (no f prefix). Merged: `f"failed, even with retries: {e}"`. The f prefix was added, so `{e}` now gets filled in.
targets.stage3_reason: The string `"failed, even with retries: {e}"` has no `f` prefix, so the error message would print a literal `{e}` instead of the underlying exception. The merged code changed it to `f"failed, even with retries: {e}"`, and anyone reading the diff could spot this.
